subject: Supported game version
text: The set developer lists the supported disc as Tekken (USA) [SLUS-00006].

evidence.quote: [jplima] Tekken (USA) [SLUS-00006]

subject: Paul
text: A commenter gives Paul's 4 hit combo as LP, RP, LK, RP.

evidence.quote: Does anyone know how to do Paul's 4 hit combo?...[DUT] LP, RP, LK, RP

subject: Ultimate Combo
text: One player reports the Ultimate Combo achievement unlocked with Kazuya without actually reaching 10 hits.

evidence.quote: achievement is bugged, I got it with Kazuya even though I didn't reach 10 hits

subject: Heihachi
object: beat Arcade mode with a normal character
text: Heihachi only unlocks when Arcade mode is beaten with a normal (not unlocked) character; beating it under 3 minutes did not unlock him otherwise.

evidence.quote: I beat arcade mode on medium in just under 3 minutes, without continues. Why didn't Heihachi unlock?
Seems you need to beat it with a normal (not unlocked) character to get Heihachi.

subject: King
text: King's df1 spam is the easiest way to cheese the five-round no-loss and under-5-minute Arcade achievements, because df1 is very plus on block and leaves the AI in block stun, but it must be spaced properly.

evidence.quote: King's df1 spam is the easiest way to cheese those achievements, though the under 5 minutes may still take you a few tries
df1 with King has insane plus frame on block and will leave the AI in massive block stun. But you're still going to have to space it properly not to get caught napping

subject: Yoshimitsu and Kunimitsu 6 hit combos
text: Players report trouble getting the Yoshimitsu and Kunimitsu 6 hit combo achievements to unlock.

evidence.quote: Yoshi's and Kuni's Combo archivement doesn't work
does anyone know why my 6-hit combo doesn't pop with Yoshi and Kunimitsu?

subject: Memory card saving
text: One commenter warns the game does not save to the memory card automatically and must be told to save, while another reports it saved automatically after finishing the game.

evidence.quote: Make sure you tell the game to save onto your memory card...it doesn't do so automatically!
For me it saved auto after I finished the game hm

subject: Ganryu
text: A player who mastered the set calls Ganryu's throw followed by a stomp extremely strong and found Ultra Hard easier than Medium.

evidence.quote: Ganryu throw and then stomp is god tier, and Ultra Hard is easier than Medium

subject: 10 hit combos
text: Spamming 1+2 produces strings like 1,2,1,2, and learning 10 hit combos with basic spacing and defense is enough to master the game.

evidence.quote: you can spam 1+2 to do stuff like 1,2,1,2). Learning those and doing some basic spacing/defense, you can master the game without much trouble.

subject: Heihachi combos
text: A player found the combo achievements long to complete, with Heihachi the hardest, and relied on a video explaining the 10 hit combos.

evidence.quote: For combos, it was pretty long, fortunately there is a very good video explaining how to do 10 combos... The hardest was with Heihachi.

subject: Character strength
text: One player rates Yoshimitsu and Kunimitsu as unreliable characters and King, Kazuya/Heihachi and Lee as absurdly strong, and reports the AI reading inputs and ducking throws.

evidence.quote: some characters being total crapshoots (Yoshi/Kuni) while others are absurdly broken (King, Kazuya/Heihachi, Lee)
ducks throws in 1 frame then throws you back, reads your inputs and attacks first

subject: Galaga
text: For the Galaga challenge the first stage is the worst; every stage has a fixed pattern of ship spawns and timings that can be learned.

evidence.quote: Honestly what makes it bearable is that its the first stage that's the worst. Once you have it down and knowing that theres a pattern to each stage of how the ships spawn in and their timings it can be done by anyone.

subject: DuckStation
text: A commenter reports the set works fine in DuckStation as of 2025.

evidence.quote: Also the set works fine in Duckstation in 2025

subject: 10 hit combos
text: Learning each character's 10 hit combo is recommended: it deals 50%-75% of the opponent's life, strings with a high-to-low mixup like King's often hit the AI, and the same combos are needed for the 6 hit achievements.

evidence.quote: just learn their 10 hit combo, it does 50%-75% of the enemies lifebar and if it has a mixup from a high to a low mid-string like King's for example the ai will usually just get hit by the low
you need to learn these anyway for the 6 hit combo achievement

subject: Character Arcade achievements
text: For the beat-Arcade-with-a-character achievements, set the game to Hard and 1 round: the Hard AI is more aggressive and leaves openings, while the Medium AI hangs back, blocks and retaliates.

evidence.quote: Do those on Hard mode. I swear the game is easier on Hard mode, because the AI is a bit more aggressive and leaves itself open for more attacks. On Medium the AI tends to stay back, and block anything you do, and immediately retaliate.
So set game to Hard, and 1 round.

subject: Five Minute Death Punch
text: One player could only beat the 5-minute Arcade achievement by spamming Lee's down kicks.

evidence.quote: just spamming lee's down kicks weren't that fun. But I genuinely tried many times and I couldn't get even close to beating 5 minutes otherwise.

subject: 6 hit combo achievements
text: A player could only unlock the 6 hit combo achievements in Arcade mode.

evidence.quote: I could only unlock 6 hit combos via arcade mode.

subject: 6 hit combo achievements
text: Players report the 6 hit combo achievements only unlock in Arcade mode, not in practice.

evidence.quote: it seems that 6 hits achievements only worked on Arcade mode.
You can't have them in practice

subject: Heihachi
text: For Heihachi's combo starter, dash and hold forward and wait until his animation returns to normal position, otherwise he performs his uppercut instead.

evidence.quote: Heihachi is finicky since for the starter you need to dash and hold forward while waiting until his animation goes to normal position or else he'll do his uppercut instead.

subject: Kunimitsu and Yoshimitsu
text: Kunimitsu's string only has 7 hits and the 2 of her 121 starter usually misses (same for Yoshimitsu), so deliberately whiff the starting 1 and hit the opponent first with the 2.

evidence.quote: Kunimitsu only have 7 hits and her 121 starter you usually miss the 2 (same as Yoshi) so basically you need to purposely miss the starter 1 and then first hit the opponent with the 2.

subject: Ultimate Combo
text: The 10 hit combo achievement can be earned in 2P mode on PCSX ReArmed, but that did not work on DuckStation.

evidence.quote: for the actual 10 hits combo, on PCSX ReArmed you can get it through 2P mode but it doesnt worked on Duckstation.

subject: Galaga
text: Galaga's first stage is the most difficult; finishing it in 18.5 seconds or less unlocks a second ship, and the later two-ship stages are much easier.

evidence.quote: The first stage is the most difficult, and you can unlock the second ship by finishing the first stage in 18.5 seconds or less. The other stages with two ships are much easier.

subject: Galaga
text: A player recommends doing the Galaga achievement first because it is probably the hardest or most tedious in the set.

evidence.quote: I recommend getting the Galaga minigame first, even though it's not related to Tekken, because it's probably the hardest, or at least the most tedious.

subject: Ultimate Combo
text: The 10 hit combo achievement was easy with Wang, and is also easy with King, Law or Michelle.

evidence.quote: Getting the 10-hit combo achievement was quite easy with Wang, but it's also easy with King, Law, or Michelle.

subject: 6 hit combo achievements
object: press RP or LP six times
text: Pressing the same RP or LP button (Square or Triangle) six times in a row earns most 6 hit combo achievements; Jack, P-Jack and Puma needed a real combo because their attacks are slow.

evidence.quote: Simply pressing the same RP or LP button (square or triangle) six times in a row will get you the achievement but with Jack, P-Jack, and Puma, I was forced to use a combo because their attacks are very slow.

subject: Character Arcade achievements
text: To unlock the per-character Arcade achievements quickly, reduce the round count to 1 and raise the difficulty to Hard, where the opponent blocks less.

evidence.quote: Another tip for quickly unlocking the arcade mode achievements for each character is to reduce the number of rounds to 1, and even change the difficulty to hard since the opponent won't block as many attacks.

subject: Galaga
text: For Galaga, hold Triangle for auto-fire and study a video of the 8 stages to learn which wave comes next.

evidence.quote: I'd advise making use of holding Triangle for auto-fire and consult a video showing off the stages
it's 8 stages in total so it's better to just check the video after you do a wave

subject: 6 hit combo achievements
text: Juggles make 6 hit combos hard in this game, so use each character's 10 string combo, which also covers the 10 hit combo achievement.

evidence.quote: the way juggling works in this game makes it pretty difficult to get 6 hit combos, you can't just launch someone and do some jabs, I'd recommend using characters 10 string combos, which will also help with the 10 hit combo achievement as well

subject: Heihachi
text: Heihachi's 10 hit combo starts by dashing (forward twice, holding forward on the second press) and pressing Triangle (2) not too quickly, or he does an uppercut; the AI is also more aggressive against him.

evidence.quote: is to dash by pressing forward twice and hold the forward button on the 2nd press and press Triangle (or 2) but not too fast otherwise he'll do an uppercut
also the AI seems to be even more aggressive with him

subject: Move list notation
text: In Tekken move-list notation 1 = Square, 2 = Triangle, 3 = Cross, 4 = Circle, f = forward, and + means pressing two buttons together; move lists are not shown in-game.

evidence.quote: 1 = Square, 2 = Triangle, 3 = Cross, 4 = Circle, f = forward, + = pressing 2 buttons at the same time.
use this website to see the move list because you can't see them in game

subject: Michelle
text: Michelle's 10 hit combo is reported as the best one for challenges that allow any character.

evidence.quote: Michelle's 10 hit combo seems to be the best one in the game for the challenges that allow any character.

subject: Heihachi 6 hit combo
text: For Heihachi's hard 6 hit combo timing, a player suggests practising in 1 vs 1 against a second player, since there is no practice mode and the CPU fights back.

evidence.quote: if there was a practice mode so the CPU isn't actively fighting against your combo attempts
Why don't you do 1 vs 1 with a player 2 and practice ?

subject: Arcade mode difficulty
text: In Arcade mode choose Hard over Medium because the AI blocks less often; Galaga and Heihachi's combo are the hardest achievements.

evidence.quote: In Arcade mode, choose Hard mode over Medium because the AI blocks your moves less often. Galaga and Heihachi's combo are by far the hardest achievements in the game.
